preconditions.description: The flag matrix dimensions n and m, and the number of segments q, must satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ 10, 1 ≤ m ≤ 10^5, and 1 ≤ q ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= m for l, r in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (l, r) must satisfy 1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ m, where queries are parsed from the input.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**6 for row in flag_matrix for x in row)
preconditions.description: All elements in the flag matrix must be positive integers not exceeding 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(flag_matrix) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in flag_matrix)
preconditions.description: The flag matrix must have exactly n rows and m columns, with each row containing exactly m integers.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly q lines, one for each query.
Each output line must be a non-negative integer representing the beauty of the corresponding segment.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(output_lines[i]) <= n * (r - l + 1) for i, (l, r) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (l, r), the beauty (number of components) must be a positive integer not exceeding the number of cells in the segment (n * (r - l + 1)).

postconditions.expression: all(beauty == count_components(flag_matrix, l, r) for i, (l, r) in enumerate(queries) for beauty in [int(output_lines[i])])
postconditions.description: For each query (l, r), the output must equal the number of connected components in the submatrix defined by columns l to r (1-based). Two cells are connected if they are adjacent (up, down, left, right) and have the same value.
